sloka: यो विधाता च धाता च सुकृतं दुष्कृतं तथा ।त्रैलोक्यं विजितं येन तं कथं विजयिष्यते ।। ७.२०.३१ ॥
transliteration: yo vidhātā ca dhātā ca sukṛtaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ tathā ।trailokyaṁ vijitaṁ yena taṁ kathaṁ vijayiṣyate ।। 7.20.31 ॥

translations.english: How can this king of Rakshasas (Ravana) personally go to conquer him, from whom the three worlds always flee, tormented by fear?
translations.hindi: महाराज इच्वाक के कुल में दाशरथी राम उत्पन्न होंगे जो तेरा वध करेंगे
